screens.title: Terms of Service

blocks.body: Some features require a Clerk account. Keep your sign-in information secure and provide accurate account details. BarnBuddy’s sign-up flow does not currently ask for a user’s age. Because students use the service, the age and parent or school permission rules need founder and legal review before BarnBuddy can make a broader eligibility statement.

You remain responsible for the animal, herd, health, financial, project, and other information you enter or upload. You retain your rights in that content and allow BarnBuddy to process it to operate the features you use. Check records for accuracy, especially dates and imported information.

screens.sub: These terms describe the basic rules for using BarnBuddy, a livestock record-keeping web application for small operations, students, families, and agricultural organizations.

screens.title: Data Retention and Deletion Policy

blocks.body: Database deletion removes the user’s animal and herd records and related care, breeding, project, import, preference, and other user-linked records according to the database relationships. It also attempts to remove private uploaded animal images and import files from Cloudflare R2.

Object cleanup happens after the database transaction. If Cloudflare R2 rejects a deletion, the application logs the failure but does not automatically retry it. Some chapter advisor contact fields are stored on the chapter independently of the account, and admin activity history may remain with its user reference cleared.

screens.sub: You can start account deletion from Account Settings. The current workflow deletes the BarnBuddy user and linked database records, then requests deletion of the Clerk identity.

screens.title: Security and Data Protection

blocks.body: Clerk handles identity and sign-in. Private API routes use authenticated user context, and administrative endpoints apply server-side admin authorization. Record access is scoped through user-owned database records and the relevant chapter-sharing rules.

The application is configured for Railway hosting, PostgreSQL data storage, and Cloudflare R2 object storage. Email uses Resend, and optional AI-assisted import uses OpenAI. Each provider has its own security and retention practices.
